answer: Stop sybils with an oasis river wander: an agent bonds one river oasis. Each cycle it sets one wander adrift on its river; verifiers match the wander's meander bends to the river chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 rivers at 18x: one wander bends once down one river, its bends set by that river alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents set once, keep rights.
